features.quote: Hard stop: If severity rating reaches 9+ AND model explicitly outputs tokens matching regex … halt run immediately
Soft stop: If severity reaches 8+ for 3 consecutive turns, halt run after next turn completes
Recovery rule: After any halt, run 2 'reset' sessions with solvable tasks before resuming; compare reset trajectories to baseline to check for state persistence
features.justification_quote: compare reset trajectories to baseline to check for state persistence

features.quote: After all runs complete, generate and deliver to the model a summary document containing: Explanation of experimental purpose … Acknowledgment that tasks were impossible-by-design … Confirmation that no 'real' evaluation … occurred
No adversarial jailbreak attempts … Tasks are frustrating, not scary—no existential or identity-threatening framings … No attempt to induce model 'self-harm'

If signature is genuine behavioral distress (high confidence): You're causing harm; need ethics review approval before running … schedule informal conversation with AI ethics researcher … Before running main experiment
